name: gappay
description: GapPay — gap (davra jamg'armasi) platformasi: NestJS backend + Next.js frontend

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=3000 pnpm --dir backend start:prod" "pnpm --dir frontend start"
